scope: Glasgow Tower at Pacific Quay in October 2023, including the round ground enclosure, rotating aerofoil shaft and bracing, glazed observation cabin and antenna.

originalReview.notes: The open side profile shows the silver aerofoil shaft, thin curved leading member, cross braces, elongated glazed pod and tall aerial. Foreshore elements partly hide the base.

quallaSearch.notes: The first-party CC0 Qualla original supplies the full side silhouette. The older transferred file and unrelated locality images were excluded. The base enclosure is mapped and the operator supplies the tower and viewing platform heights.
